returns.title: Fictional shop: ordinary return policy
returns.scope: Unopened ordinary items returned for non-defect reasons; excludes custom items and other unspecified cases
returns.rule: Eligible items delivered no more than 14 days ago may be returned for the item amount less a 5% fee on the item subtotal.

shipping.title: Fictional shop: original shipping policy
shipping.rule: Original shipping is not refundable. The calculate_refund item_subtotal includes only the item amount, excluding original shipping.

rounding.title: Monetary calculation rules
rounding.rule: The item subtotal has at most two decimal places. Round the fee to cents using ROUND_HALF_UP before subtracting it from the item subtotal.
